rules.name: unsupported-encoding
rules.title: INW000 unsupported-encoding
rules.summary: A declared source encoding under which a comment can be a real import
rules.description: A file in a layer declares a source encoding under which text Inwards reads as a comment can be a real import to Python. The file is reported instead of checked.

rules.name: layer-dependency
rules.title: INW001 layer-dependency
rules.summary: An import from an inner layer into an outer one
rules.description: An inner layer imports an outer one. Dependencies must point toward inner layers.

rules.name: context-independence
rules.title: INW002 context-independence
rules.summary: An import from one bounded context into another its `depends-on` doesn't declare
rules.description: A bounded context or vertical slice imports another context only when its depends-on declares that context.

rules.name: public-api-only
rules.title: INW003 public-api-only
rules.summary: An import of a context's module that isn't public, from outside the context
rules.description: Code outside a bounded context imports only the modules the context declares public.

rules.name: import-cycles
rules.title: INW004 import-cycles
rules.summary: Modules, or bounded contexts, that import each other in a cycle (whole-project runs)
rules.description: Modules, or bounded contexts, don't import each other in a cycle. Checked on whole-project runs, with the full path of each cycle.

rules.name: pure-domain
rules.title: INW005 pure-domain
rules.summary: A library import a layer's config doesn't allow, such as SQLAlchemy in the domain
rules.description: A layer imports a third-party or standard-library module its config doesn't let it use. The innermost layer denies frameworks, database and network clients and stdlib I/O by default.

rules.name: unassigned-module
rules.title: INW006 unassigned-module
rules.summary: First-party code outside every layer, and layer prefixes that match nothing
rules.description: First-party code must belong to a layer, and every layer prefix must match modules. Reports imports into code outside every layer, packages outside every layer, and dead prefixes.

rules.name: package-shape
rules.title: INW007 package-shape
rules.summary: A package member its shape doesn't allow, or a name outside the packages it belongs in
rules.description: A package holds only the members its configured shape allows, and names stay in the packages they belong in.

rules.name: missing-member
rules.title: INW008 missing-member
rules.summary: A member a package's shape requires is missing
rules.description: A package holds every member its configured shape requires.

rules.name: suppression-comment
rules.title: INW009 suppression-comment
rules.summary: An inline suppression that hides nothing, or matches no finding
rules.description: An inline suppression names rules that can be suppressed, gives a reason, and hides a finding.

rules.name: unknown-first-party
rules.title: INW010 unknown-first-party
rules.summary: An import of a first-party module that doesn't exist
rules.description: An imported first-party module must exist. Catches hallucinated modules and relative imports that climb above the top-level package.

rules.name: dynamic-import
rules.title: INW011 dynamic-import
rules.summary: A dynamic import that reaches an outer layer, or whose target Inwards can't read
rules.description: Dynamic imports (importlib, __import__, runpy, exec) must point toward inner layers too. In inner layers, a target Inwards can't read is reported as unverifiable.

rules.name: thin-endpoint
rules.title: INW012 thin-endpoint
rules.summary: An HTTP endpoint that does the work itself: too many statements, branches or loops, database or HTTP calls of its own, or no call into the layer `delegate-to` names
rules.description: An HTTP endpoint reads the request, calls one use case and shapes the response; the logic, queries and outgoing calls live in other layers.

rules.name: async-blocking
rules.title: INW013 async-blocking
rules.summary: A synchronous database, cache or cloud call inside `async def`: a sync SQLAlchemy `Session`, `redis.Redis`, boto3 or a blocking driver
rules.description: An async def makes no synchronous database, cache or cloud call, itself or through a sync helper it calls; a sync SQLAlchemy Session, redis.Redis, boto3 or a blocking driver stalls the event loop.

rules.name: ports-abstract
rules.title: INW014 ports-abstract
rules.summary: A class in a port module that isn't an ABC or a Protocol, or a port method whose body does work
rules.description: A port module holds only ABCs and Protocols whose methods have no body; implementations live in adapters.

rules.name: construct-only-in
rules.title: INW015 construct-only-in
rules.summary: A module outside the composition root that imports an outbound adapter, or another guarded role, at runtime, or builds one of its classes
rules.description: Only the composition root imports and builds the modules of a guarded role, such as the outbound adapters; everything else takes them through a port.

rules.name: orm-naming
rules.title: INW016 orm-naming
rules.summary: A table name that isn't lower_case_snake and singular, or a datetime or date column without `_at` or `_date`; a whole-project run also wants a `MetaData` naming convention
rules.description: ORM table names and the names of datetime and date columns follow the project's scheme, by default lower_case_snake singular tables, _at for datetimes and _date for dates, and SQLAlchemy models get a MetaData naming convention.

rules.name: diagram-unknown-name
rules.title: INW017 diagram-unknown-name
rules.summary: A node in a marked Mermaid architecture diagram that names no declared layer or context, or whose quoted label matches no module (whole-project runs)
rules.description: A node in a marked architecture diagram names a layer or context [tool.inwards] declares, and its quoted label a module that exists.

rules.name: diagram-forbidden-edge
rules.title: INW018 diagram-forbidden-edge
rules.summary: A solid arrow in a marked Mermaid architecture diagram that draws an import the config forbids: outward or between sibling layers, between contexts without `depends-on`, or into a module that isn't `public` (whole-project runs)
rules.description: A solid arrow in a marked architecture diagram draws only imports [tool.inwards] allows.

rules.name: endpoint-metadata
rules.title: FAPI001 endpoint-metadata
rules.summary: A path operation without the OpenAPI metadata the project requires (summary, response model, status code)
rules.description: A FastAPI path operation in the OpenAPI schema lacks metadata the project requires, such as a summary, a response model or an explicit status code.

rules.name: undocumented-error-response
rules.title: FAPI002 undocumented-error-response
rules.summary: A path operation that can produce an error status code (raised directly, in a helper or dependency, or through an app's exception handler) its `responses=` doesn't declare
rules.description: A FastAPI path operation can produce an error status code, directly, through a helper or dependency, or through an app's exception handler, that its OpenAPI entry doesn't declare.

rules.name: router-wiring
rules.title: FAPI003 router-wiring
rules.summary: An `APIRouter` with routes that no app includes, routers that include each other in a cycle, or an `include_router` above the included router's routes
rules.description: Every APIRouter with routes is included in an app, and no routers include each other in a cycle.

rules.name: route-shadowing
rules.title: FAPI005 route-shadowing
rules.summary: A path operation that an earlier one with the same method already answers: `/users/{id}` above `/users/me`, or the same method and path twice
rules.description: No FastAPI path operation is shadowed by an earlier one with the same method, so every route can be reached.

rules.name: lifespan-events
rules.title: FAPI006 lifespan-events
rules.summary: A deprecated `on_event` handler or `on_startup=` (a warning), and one next to a `lifespan=` that makes FastAPI ignore it (an error)
rules.description: FastAPI apps use a lifespan context manager, not the deprecated on_event handlers, and never both, so every startup and shutdown handler runs.

rules.name: yield-dependency-swallows
rules.title: FAPI007 yield-dependency-swallows
rules.summary: A dependency with `yield` whose `except` clause around it doesn't re-raise, so the endpoint's error is hidden
rules.description: A dependency with yield re-raises what its except clauses catch, so an error in the endpoint is not hidden from the server.

rules.name: duplicate-operation-id
rules.title: FAPI008 duplicate-operation-id
rules.summary: Two path operations of one app with the same literal `operation_id`
rules.description: No two path operations of one FastAPI app share an explicit operation_id, so generated clients get one method per operation.

rules.name: depends-called
rules.title: FAPI009 depends-called
rules.summary: `Depends(get_db())`: the dependency is called at import time instead of being passed
rules.description: Depends and Security get the dependency function, not the result of calling it at import time.
